title: Tinkers' Ad astra
description: Add some upgrades using Ad Astra materials.
body:
### 添加的强化：
1. 耐热金属升级，对标航天服，+1护甲+2韧性
2. 星球仪，+1能力槽
3. 太空画作，+1升级槽
### Added upgrades: 
1. Calorite upgrade, comparable to jet suit, +1 armor, +2 armor toughness;
2. Globe, +1 ability slot; 
3. Space Painting, +1 upgrade slot.
